cards.name: Chrono-Saur Rex
cards.audit_note: Rejected the reported face-down-selection finding. Official archetype-qualified destruction selections require an on-field named card to be face-up; the current filter correctly allows only face-up Chrono-Saur cards or face-up Dinosaur monsters.

coverage_override.reason: Each Summon effect includes its delayed self-destruction consequence and corresponding clause of the final each-effect HOPT sentence.

effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase 1 or Battle Phase (Quick Effect): You can destroy 1 "Chrono-Saur" card or 1 Dinosaur monster you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card from hand. Destroy this card Summoned this way at the end of the Phase it was Summoned. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The hand HOPT Quick Effect operates only in Main Phase 1 or the Battle Phase, destroys one face-up controlled archetype card or Dinosaur monster, summons this card only after successful destruction, and schedules destruction at that phase's end.

official_references.matched_structure: Official archetype-qualified 'destroy 1 ... card you control' filter requires the named on-field card to be face-up.
Official sequential effect gates a later operation on successful destruction.
Official phase-end follow-up uses a registered phase event tied to the affected card.

effects.printed_clause: When you declare an attack: You can Special Summon this card from your GY, but destroy this card at the end of the Battle Phase. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A GY HOPT EVENT_ATTACK_ANNOUNCE trigger requires the controller's attack, revives this card through Necrovalley, and schedules its destruction at Battle Phase end.

official_references.matched_structure: Official GY self-Special-Summon effect checks summon legality and performs Duel.SpecialSummon.
